name: Pre-Hispanic Town of Uxmal
description: Uxmal is a Maya city in Mexico's Yucatán, about 62 km south of Mérida, built between roughly 700 and 1000 AD. Its five-tiered Pyramid of the Magician rises above a ceremonial centre of Puuc-style buildings, whose smooth walls give way to friezes of lattice patterns, coiled snakes and hook-nosed masks of the rain god Chaac. The huge Governor's Palace is a highlight.
